name: Henmi Sora
source:
Part of unit Re:Fly

Likes anything related to the space and stars, he often spends time alone vacantly looking at the sky.
He admires Cosmo to a point of worship.
He has a compassionate side and is willing to raise his voice for his friends.
translation:
Part of unit Re:Fly

Likes anything related to the space and stars, he often spends time alone vacantly looking at the sky.
He admires Cosmo to a point of worship.
He has a compassionate side and is willing to raise his voice for his friends.
